<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<meta name="theme-color" content="#101e25"><meta name="description" content="Steer the Black Flag fleet through Sunset Harbor in a three-boat arcade regatta.">
<title>Black Flag Regatta · Harbor Arcade</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64," type="image/svg+xml">
<style>:root{color-scheme:dark;--ink:#0d1b23;--panel:#182a32;--cream:#f3f0de;--muted:#a8b7b4;--mint:#87d7bc;--orange:#ff9e68;--line:#344850;--mono:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,"Courier New",monospace}

.boat[aria-pressed=true] .boat-content{padding:11px 15px 12px}.boat-art{height:clamp(110px,10vw,144px);position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-bottom:1px solid #445953;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 83%,#719489 0%,#41626a 22%,#253e46 62%,#20353b 100%)}

.boat[data-i="2"] .boat-art{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 81%,#9ebba0,#546f68 24%,#354b49 64%,#2d3d40)}

.race-top{margin:0 0 10px}.race-name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#e7ddc5}.race-name .checkers{color:var(--orange)}
.stage{height:clamp(270px,calc(100svh - 248px),700px);min-height:230px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#0c3444;border:1px solid #52666b;border-radius:7px}
#course{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none}
.telemetry{display:flex;position:absolute;top:15px;left:15px;gap:10px}.telemetry div{min-width:75px;background:#122830df;border:1px solid #8aab9a69;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:3px}.telemetry small,.telemetry strong{display:block}.telemetry small{font-size:8px;color:#a7d5c4}.telemetry strong{font:750 clamp(20px,2.1vw,28px)/1 system-ui,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-top:6px;color:#fff1c8}
.track{position:absolute;top:19px;right:17px;width:22%;height:7px;background:#11303ce6;border:1px solid #658684}.track:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-3px;top:-4px;height:12px;width:4px;background:#fff0c9}.track span{display:block;width:0;height:100%;background:var(--mint)}
#race-message{position:absolute;top:22%;width:100%;text-align:center;font:800 clamp(12px,1.5vw,19px) var(--mono);color:#fff3cd;text-shadow:1px 2px #203637;pointer-events:none}
.control-row{margin-top:12px;gap:10px}.steering{display:flex;gap:9px}.steering button{background:#263d46;border:1px solid #67828b;box-shadow:0 3px #0e161c;color:#f6f0db;font-size:24px;width:clamp(68px,8vw,110px);height:54px;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.steering button.held{background:#43636c}.race-hint{font:600 12px var(--mono);color:#c2cfbf;text-align:center}#gust{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;height:54px;font-size:16px;background:var(--mint);border-color:#a4e7d5;box-shadow:0 3px #38776c}#gust:disabled{background:#243941;border-color:#465e66;color:#a7b6b4;box-shadow:none}
.countdown{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-content:center;justify-items:center;background:#0b222659;pointer-events:none}.countdown div{font-size:12px;color:#fff3c5}.countdown strong{font:italic 700 98px Georgia,serif;color:#ffdf9e;text-shadow:0 4px 16px #1b2e3199}
dialog{position:fixed;color:var(--cream);background:#162933;border:1px solid #729389;border-radius:9px;width:min(438px,92vw);padding:0;box-shadow:0 18px 90px #071620bb;max-height:90svh}dialog::backdrop{background:#071519d9}.dialog-frame{padding:23px 24px 25px}.dialog-head{margin-bottom:7px}.close{font:26px/1 system-ui;width:38px;min-height:38px;padding:0}.dialog-frame h2{font-size:31px;margin-bottom:15px}.dialog-frame p{line-height:1.5;color:#c9d6ce}.dialog-frame ol{padding:0;margin:0;list-style:none}.rule,.result-line,.log-row{padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);line-height:1.4}.rule strong{color:#ffcd94}.result-line,.log-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.detail,.log-row small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#afc2be;margin-top:4px}.result-line b{color:var(--mint)}#modal-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}#modal-actions .action{min-width:0}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}
@media(min-width:900px) and (max-height:810px){.mast-inner{height:56px}main{padding-top:17px}.poster{height:clamp(213px,29vh,250px)}.setup{margin-top:20px}.boat-art{height:94px}.launch{margin-top:14px;padding-top:13px}}

@media(max-width:450px){.boats{grid-template-columns:1fr}.boat,.boat[aria-pressed=true]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr;align-items:stretch}.boat-art{height:66px;border-bottom:none;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}.boat[aria-pressed=true] .boat-art{margin:0}.boat-content,.boat[aria-pressed=true] .boat-content{padding:6px 28px 6px 11px}.pick{top:11px;right:10px}.builder{font-size:9px}.boat-name{font-size:18px}.perk{font-size:11px}.poster{height:170px}.poster-copy{padding:13px}.setup{margin-top:14px}.launch .action{min-width:124px}.start-info small{max-width:180px}.section-title h2{font-size:24px}}
@media(max-height:520px) and (orientation:landscape){body.playing .mast{display:none}body.playing main{padding-top:4px;width:calc(100% - 18px)}.race-top{height:34px;margin:0 0 3px}.race-top button{min-height:30px}.stage{height:calc(100svh - 102px);min-height:115px}.control-row{margin-top:4px}.steering button,#gust{height:45px;min-height:42px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}
.finish-banner{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;background:#223c43;border:1px solid #395d60;border-radius:5px;padding:7px 11px;margin-bottom:13px}.finish-boat img{display:block;width:92px;image-rendering:auto}.finish-banner small,.finish-banner strong{display:block}.finish-banner small{color:#b4c3b5}.finish-banner strong{font-size:20px}
</style>

<body>
<header class="mast"><div class="mast-inner"><div class="brand"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt=""><span>Black Flag <b>Arcade</b></span></div><nav aria-label="Arcade controls"><button id="sound" class="nav-button" aria-pressed="false"><span class="icon" data-icon="sound"></span><span id="sound-text">Sound off</span></button><button id="log" class="nav-button"><span class="icon" data-icon="log"></span><span>Race log</span></button></nav></div></header>
<main>
<section id="dock" aria-label="Race setup">
<div class="poster"><div class="poster-art"></div><div class="poster-fade"></div>
<div class="poster-copy"><div class="cup"><span class="checkers"></span> HARBOR CUP</div>
<h1>Black Flag<br><span>Regatta</span></h1><div class="course-tag"><span class="icon" data-icon="pin"></span> Sunset Harbor <i></i> 1,200 m sprint</div></div>
</div>
<div class="setup"><div class="section-title"><div><div class="kicker"><i></i> RACE ENTRY</div><h2>Choose your boat</h2></div><button class="help-link" id="help"><span class="question">?</span> How to race</button></div>
<div class="boats" role="group" aria-label="Choose your boat"></div>
<div class="launch"><div class="start-info"><span class="checkers"></span><div><strong>Sunset Harbor Sprint</strong><small>3 boats <b>·</b> 1 power gust <b>·</b> First across wins</small></div></div><button id="start" class="action">Start race <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button></div></div>
</section>
<section id="race" hidden aria-label="Sunset Harbor race">
<div class="race-top"><div class="race-name"><span class="checkers"></span> SUNSET HARBOR</div><button class="nav-button" id="pause">Ⅱ   Pause</button></div>
<div class="stage"><canvas id="course" aria-label="Race course. Steer left or right through cyan currents and avoid the red channel buoys."></canvas>
<div class="telemetry"><div><small>POSITION</small><strong id="rank">1 / 3</strong></div><div><small>TIME</small><strong id="time">0:00.0</strong></div></div>
<div class="track"><span></span></div><div id="race-message"></div>
<div class="countdown" hidden><div id="count-label">STARTING SIGNAL</div><strong id="count-number">3</strong></div></div>
<div class="control-row"><div class="steering"><button id="left" aria-label="Steer left">◀</button><button id="right" aria-label="Steer right">▶</button></div><div class="race-hint" id="hint">Steer into the cyan currents</div><button id="gust"><span class="icon" data-icon="wind"></span><span id="gust-label">Power gust</span></button></div>
<div id="announce" class="sr" role="status"></div>
</section>
</main>
<dialog id="modal" aria-labelledby="modal-title"><div class="dialog-frame"><div class="dialog-head"><div id="modal-kicker" class="kicker"></div><button id="close" class="close" aria-label="Close dialog">×</button></div><h2 id="modal-title"></h2><div id="modal-body"></div><div id="modal-actions"></div></div></dialog>
<script>"use strict";
const Boats = [
  {name:"Copper Clipper",builder:"Legacy Plumbing",perk:"Quick off the line",speed:26.8,turn:1.24,accel:13,color:"#f89b68"},
  {name:"Petal Pusher",builder:"Becca’s Bloom Shop",perk:"Nimble in the turns",speed:26.3,turn:1.63,accel:9.7,color:"#f2c455"},
  {name:"Knot Today",builder:"Ike’s Wood Signs",perk:"Fast on the straights",speed:28.2,turn:1.15,accel:8.1,color:"#8ed9c3"}
];
const Art = (() => {
  const image = source => {
    const art = new Image();
    art.decoding = "async";
    art.src = source;
    return art;
  };
  const boats = ["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"].map(image);
  const harbor = image("data:image/webp;base64,");
  function portrait(id) {
    const img = boats[id].cloneNode();
    img.alt = "";
    return img;
  }
  return {boats, harbor, brig: image("data:image/webp;base64,"), waterline: .495, portrait};
})();
</script><script>"use strict";
const HarborView = (() => {
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const clamp = (value, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, value));
  function ellipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry, fill) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill();
  }
  function random(index) {
    const n = Math.sin(index * 127.1 + 39.7) * 43758.5453;
    return n - Math.floor(n);
  }
  function stroke(ctx, points, width, color) {
    if (points.length < 2) return;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);
    for (let i = 1; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
      const a = points[i], b = points[i+1];
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(a.x, a.y, (a.x+b.x)/2, (a.y+b.y)/2);
    }
    const end = points[points.length-1];
    ctx.lineTo(end.x, end.y); ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = width; ctx.stroke();
  }

  let harborPlate = null;
  // Resample the painting once at display resolution. The water strips then move
  // independently without rescaling the original detailed illustration every frame.
  function getPlate(ctx,w,h,waterline,art) {
    const density = Math.min(1.65,ctx.getTransform().a);
    if(harborPlate && harborPlate.w===w && harborPlate.h===h && harborPlate.density===density) return harborPlate;
    const cut=art.naturalHeight*Art.waterline;
    const scale=Math.max(w*1.20/art.naturalWidth,waterline/cut);
    const dw=art.naturalWidth*scale, skyHeight=cut*scale;
    const width=Math.ceil(w*1.20), canvas=document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width=Math.ceil(width*density);canvas.height=Math.ceil(h*density);
    const c=canvas.getContext("2d");c.scale(canvas.width/width,canvas.height/h);
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;c.imageSmoothingQuality="high";
    const x=(width-dw)*.5;
    c.drawImage(art,0,0,art.naturalWidth,cut+1,x,waterline-skyHeight,dw,skyHeight+1);
    c.drawImage(art,0,cut,art.naturalWidth,art.naturalHeight-cut,x,waterline,dw,h-waterline);
    harborPlate={w,h,density,canvas,width,light:x+dw*.261};return harborPlate;
  }
  function backdrop(ctx, w, h, state, m) {
    const art=Art.harbor, waterline=m.horizon, t=state.clock;
    let lightX=w*.3;
    if (art.complete && art.naturalWidth) {
      const plate=getPlate(ctx,w,h,waterline,art);
      const approach=m.p.s/1200, zoom=1+.09*approach;
      const pan=w*(.037*Math.sin(approach*6.4)-m.p.x*.025);
      const origin=(w-plate.width*zoom)*.5+pan;
      const y=waterline*(1-zoom), dh=h*zoom;
      const screenWidth=plate.width*zoom;
      ctx.drawImage(plate.canvas,origin,y,screenWidth,dh);
      // Keep the quays and moored boats still. Only open water undulates.
      const start=waterline+(h-waterline)*.14;
      const bands=23;
      for(let row=0;row<bands;row++){
        const u=row/bands,v=(row+1)/bands;
        const top=start+(h-start)*u, height=(h-start)*(v-u);
        const shift=(Math.sin(t*1.25-u*14)+.55*Math.sin(t*1.78+u*26))*u*2.6;
        const heave=Math.sin(t*1.1-u*16)*u*1.7;
        const sourceY=(top-y-heave)/dh*plate.canvas.height;
        const sourceHeight=(height+1)/dh*plate.canvas.height;
        ctx.drawImage(plate.canvas,0,Math.max(0,sourceY),plate.canvas.width,sourceHeight,
          origin+shift,top,screenWidth,height+1);
      }
      lightX=origin+plate.light*zoom;
    }else{
      const sea=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);
      sea.addColorStop(0,"#c4d2cc");sea.addColorStop(.43,"#7aa4a5");sea.addColorStop(1,"#155263");
      ctx.fillStyle=sea;ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
    }
    const glaze = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, waterline, 0, h);
    glaze.addColorStop(0,"rgba(2,44,49,0)");glaze.addColorStop(.5,"rgba(4,50,60,.12)");glaze.addColorStop(1,"rgba(2,47,58,.42)");
    ctx.fillStyle = glaze; ctx.fillRect(0,waterline,w,h-waterline);
    // Glints occupy fixed patches of water. They widen and drift past with the boats.
    const first = Math.floor((m.p.s-29)/3);
    for (let j=first; j<first+108; j++) {

    })
  }boatCards();
  const canvas=$("course"),ctx=canvas.getContext("2d",{alpha:false}),modal=$("modal");
  let sceneWidth=1, sceneHeight=1;
  function renderRace(){
    const ratioX=canvas.width/sceneWidth, ratioY=canvas.height/sceneHeight;
    ctx.setTransform(ratioX,0,0,ratioY,0,0);
    Regatta.draw(ctx,sceneWidth,sceneHeight);
  }
  function measure(){
    if(mode!=="race")return;
    const box=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(!box.width||!box.height)return;
    sceneWidth=box.width; sceneHeight=box.height;
    const density=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2,Math.sqrt(2400000/(sceneWidth*sceneHeight)));
    const w=Math.round(sceneWidth*density),h=Math.round(sceneHeight*density);
    if(canvas.width!==w||canvas.height!==h){canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h}
    renderRace();
  }
  if(window.ResizeObserver)new ResizeObserver(measure).observe(canvas);else addEventListener("resize",measure);
  function setHidden(el,value){el.hidden=value}
  function toDock(){
    stop();mode="dock";Regatta.resetControls();document.body.classList.remove("playing");setHidden($("race"),true);setHidden($("dock"),false);
    $("start").focus({preventScroll:true})
  }
  function closeModal(){
    if(modal.open)modal.close();
    if(dialogType==="finish")toDock();
    else if(pendingResume&&mode==="race"&&!document.hidden){Regatta.resume();last=0;loop()}
    pendingResume=false;dialogType=""
  }
  function showDialog(type,kicker,title,body,actions,resumeOnClose=false){
    if(modal.open)modal.close();
    dialogType=type;pendingResume=resumeOnClose;$("modal-kicker").textContent=kicker;$("modal-title").textContent=title;$("modal-body").innerHTML=body;
    const wrap=$("modal-actions");wrap.replaceChildren();actions.forEach(([label,fn,primary])=>{
      const b=document.createElement("button");b.className=primary?"action":"secondary";b.textContent=label;b.onclick=fn;wrap.append(b)
    });modal.showModal()
  }
  $("close").onclick=closeModal;modal.addEventListener("cancel",e=>{e.preventDefault();closeModal()});
  modal.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target!==modal)return;const b=modal.getBoundingClientRect();if(e.clientX<b.left||e.clientX>b.right||e.clientY<b.top||e.clientY>b.bottom)closeModal()});
  $("help").onclick=()=>showDialog("help","SKIPPER’S BRIEFING","How to race",
    '<ol><li class="rule"><strong>1. Take the helm.</strong> Your boat sails forward on its own. Hold ◀ or ▶, or slide your finger across the water to steer.</li><li class="rule"><strong>2. Read the water.</strong> Cross the glowing cyan chevrons for speed. The tall red-and-white buoys slow you down.</li><li class="rule"><strong>3. Call your gust.</strong> Tap Power gust once per race for a burst of speed. First across the checkered line wins.</li></ol><p class="detail">Keyboard: ← / → or A / D to steer, Space for your gust, P to pause.</p>',
    [["Back to dock",closeModal,true]]);
  function holdRace(){if(!Regatta.pause())return false;stop();clearHolds();return true}
  $("log").onclick=()=>{
    const paused=mode==="race"&&holdRace();let rows='<p>Finish a race to record your time on this device.</p>';
    if(saved.history.length){rows=saved.history.map(r=>'<div class="log-row"><span><strong>'+Boats[r.id].name+'</strong><small>Sunset Harbor · '+ordinal(r.rank)+' place</small></span><b>'+fmt(r.time)+'</b></div>').join("")}
    showDialog("log","SUNSET HARBOR","Race log",rows,[[paused?"Resume race":"Back to dock",closeModal,true]],paused)
  };
  function showPause(){if(!holdRace())return;showDialog("pause","SUNSET HARBOR","Race paused","<p>Your boat is holding position.</p>",[
    ["Resume race",closeModal,true],["Back to dock",()=>{pendingResume=false;closeModal();toDock()},false]],true)}
  $("pause").onclick=showPause;
  function finish(result){
    const prior=saved.best[result.id],record=prior===undefined||result.time<prior;
    if(record)saved.best[result.id]=result.time;saved.history.unshift(result);saved.history=saved.history.slice(0,12);save();
    const b=Boats[result.id],title=["","You won the cup!","Second on the water","Across the line!"][result.rank];
    let body='<div class="finish-banner"><span class="finish-boat"></span><div><small>'+b.builder+'</small><strong>'+b.name+'</strong></div></div>'+
      '<div class="result-line"><span>Finish position</span><b>'+ordinal(result.rank)+' of 3</b></div><div class="result-line"><span>Race time</span><b>'+fmt(result.time)+'</b></div><div class="result-line"><span>Boat best</span><b>'+fmt(saved.best[result.id])+(record&&prior!==undefined?' ★':'')+'</b></div><div class="result-line"><span>Currents caught</span><b>'+result.currents+' / 12</b></div>';
    showDialog("finish","CHECKERED FLAG",title,body,[["Race again",()=>{dialogType="";closeModal();startRace()},true],["Change boat",closeModal,false]]);
    document.querySelector(".finish-boat").append(Art.portrait(result.id));
    [392,494,587,784].forEach((f,i)=>tone(f,.22,"triangle",i*.12));$("announce").textContent=ordinal(result.rank)+" place, "+fmt(result.time)
  }
  function event(type,value){
    switch(type){
      case "count":setHidden(document.querySelector(".countdown"),false);$("count-number").textContent=value;tone(370,.10,"triangle");break;
      case "go":setHidden(document.querySelector(".countdown"),true);$("gust").disabled=false;tone(740,.25,"triangle");break;
      case "gust":$("gust").disabled=true;$("gust-label").textContent="Gust used";tone(330,.14,"triangle");tone(590,.18,"triangle",.08);break;
      case "hit":tone(98,.16,"sawtooth");break;
      case "flow":tone(630,.12,"sine");tone(810,.15,"sine",.09);break;
      case "notice":$("announce").textContent=value;break;
      case "segment":$("hint").textContent=value.toLowerCase().replace(/\b\w/g,ch=>ch.toUpperCase());break;
      case "finish":finish(value);break;
    }
  }
  function startRace(){
    stop();mode="race";setHidden($("dock"),true);setHidden($("race"),false);document.body.classList.add("playing");
    window.scrollTo(0,0);prepareAudio();clearHolds();$("gust-label").textContent="Power gust";$("gust").disabled=true;
    $("hint").textContent="Steer into the cyan currents";$("race-message").textContent="";
    Regatta.start(saved.boat,event);measure();last=0;loop();$("pause").focus({preventScroll:true})
  }
  $("start").onclick=startRace;
  function updateHUD(){
    const s=Regatta.state,p=s.racers[0];$("rank").textContent=ordinal(Regatta.position()).toUpperCase()+"/3";
    $("time").textContent=fmt(s.clock);document.querySelector(".track span").style.width=(100*p.s/Regatta.length)+"%";
    $("race-message").textContent=s.flashTime>0?s.flash:"";$("race-message").style.opacity=Math.min(1,s.flashTime*3);
  }
  function stop(){if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0}
  function frame(now){
    raf=0;if(mode!=="race"||Regatta.state.phase==="paused")return;
    const elapsed=last?Math.min(.12,(now-last)/1000):0;last=now;let left=elapsed;
    while(left>0){const part=Math.min(left,1/60);Regatta.tick(part);left-=part}
    renderRace();updateHUD();if(Regatta.state.phase!=="finish")loop()
  }
  function loop(){if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
  const keyMap={ArrowLeft:"left",KeyA:"left",ArrowRight:"right",KeyD:"right"};
  function clearHolds(){Regatta.resetControls();for(const dir of ["left","right"])$(dir).classList.remove("held")}
  function steer(dir,on){Regatta.steering(dir,on);$(dir).classList.toggle("held",on)}
  ["left","right"].forEach(dir=>{
    const b=$(dir);b.onpointerdown=e=>{e.preventDefault();b.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);steer(dir,true)};
    b.onlostpointercapture=b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=()=>steer(dir,false);
  });
  let pointer=null,origin=0,lane=0;
  canvas.onpointerdown=e=>{if(pointer!==null||Regatta.state?.phase!=="racing")return;pointer=e.pointerId;origin=e.clientX;lane=Regatta.state.racers[0].x;canvas.setPointerCapture(pointer);Regatta.drag(lane)};
  canvas.onpointermove=e=>{if(pointer===e.pointerId)Regatta.drag(lane+(e.clientX-origin)/(canvas.clientWidth*.26))};
  canvas.onpointercancel=canvas.onlostpointercapture=canvas.onpointerup=e=>{if(pointer===e.pointerId){pointer=null;Regatta.drag(null)}};
  $("gust").onclick=()=>Regatta.gust();
  window.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
    if(modal.open||mode!=="race")return;
    if(keyMap[e.code]){e.preventDefault();steer(keyMap[e.code],true)}
    if(e.code==="Space"){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)Regatta.gust()}
    if((e.code==="KeyP"||e.code==="Escape")&&!e.repeat){e.preventDefault();showPause()}
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup",e=>{if(mode==="race"&&keyMap[e.code]){e.preventDefault();steer(keyMap[e.code],false)}});
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{if(document.hidden&&mode==="race"&&!modal.open)showPause()});
  window.addEventListener("blur",()=>{clearHolds();if(mode==="race"&&!modal.open)showPause()});
}
function receiveEntry(event) {
  if (parent === window || event.source !== parent || event.data?.type !== 'regatta:enter') return;
  window.removeEventListener('message', receiveEntry);
  openRegatta(event.data.state);
}
window.addEventListener('message', receiveEntry);
parent.postMessage({type:'regatta:ready'}, '*');
</script>
</body></html>
